name: Gmail bridge labels
author: Luca Zanon
description: Names and colours tags after the labels a Gmail account keeps, as reported by the legacy-proxy Gmail bridge, and optionally shows Gmail's inbox categories as tabs.

hideAdoptedTags.label: Keep adopted labels out of the Tags list
hideAdoptedTags.description: Every Gmail label is already a folder. Adopted tags still name and colour the label on each message.

nestedNames.label: Name nested labels by their last level
nestedNames.description: Match this to the nested tags setting: on, "Clients/Acme" is called "Acme" under "Clients".

categoryTabs.label: Show Gmail's inbox categories as tabs
categoryTabs.description: Primary, Social, Promotions, Updates and Forums above the inbox of a Gmail account.
